title: 3.2.0-dev-i TDD screen shows AndroidAPS logo in the background, making it difficult to read TDD stats
symptom: On a test KKM phone, the TDD screen shows the AndroidAPS logo in the background, and the white portions of the logo make the white TDD stats text hard to read. Previous AndroidAPS versions kept the background fully black in this screen.
evidence_quote: On a test KKM phone, I saw that the TDD screen shows the AndroidAPS logo in the background, which isn't good, because the white portions of the logo make the white TDD stats text hard to read.
